Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189)

This visa lets invited skilled workers live and work permanently anywhere in Australia. It is points-tested and does not require an employer sponsor.

Overview

The subclass 189 visa is a permanent residence visa for skilled workers who are not sponsored by an employer, a state or a territory. You must be invited to apply through SkillSelect.

Eligibility

To be invited to apply you must meet all of the following requirements at the time of invitation.

  • You must be under 40 years of age when you are invited.
  • Your occupation must be on the relevant skilled occupation list.
  • You must have a positive skills assessment from the relevant assessing authority.
  • You must score at least competent English.

Points requirement

You must score at least 67 points on the points test to be eligible for an invitation. Points are awarded for age, English language ability, skilled employment experience and qualifications.

Invitations are issued to the highest scoring candidates in each occupation, so in practice the competitive score is often higher than the pass mark.

English language requirements

You must provide evidence of at least competent English, which can be shown through an accepted English language test or through specified passport holding.

Changes from 1 July 2026

From 1 July 2026 the minimum age for invited applicants drops from 45 to 40 and the points pass mark rises to 67. Applicants invited before that date are assessed under the previous settings.

Processing times

Processing times vary by occupation and application volume. Most applications are finalised within 6 to 12 months of lodgement.
